chunks_embedding_dims_check.name: chunks_embedding_dims_check
chunks_embedding_dims_check.value: embedding IS NULL OR vector_dims(embedding) = dims

invites_reset_check.name: invites_reset_check
invites_reset_check.value: reset_user_id IS NULL OR (grants = '[]'::jsonb AND NOT is_admin AND NOT shared_editor)

items_memory_shape_check.name: items_memory_shape_check
items_memory_shape_check.value: (space = 'memories') = (type IS NOT NULL AND confidence IS NOT NULL)

items_status_check.name: items_status_check
items_status_check.value: CASE space WHEN 'decisions' THEN status IN ('proposed','accepted','superseded','deprecated') ELSE status IN ('active','superseded') END

items_archived_check.name: items_archived_check
items_archived_check.value: (lifecycle = 'archived') = (archived_at IS NOT NULL AND archive_reason IS NOT NULL)

tokens_kind_shape_check.name: tokens_kind_shape_check
tokens_kind_shape_check.value: (kind = 'user' AND user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind = 'service' AND user_id IS NULL AND role IS NOT NULL)
